name: AirportCams
description: Wall display of Flightradar24's live YouTube airport cameras (LHR, LGA, LAS, SXM and more) in a grid that fits the screen. A Cloudflare Worker keeps the list of live cameras current, and you can choose and reorder cameras, listen to one, enlarge one, or add any YouTube stream.

paragraphs: A wall-display page that shows Flightradar24's live airport cameras from YouTube side by side, with controls to pick which cameras are shown.

Tip: Sign in to YouTube in the browser you watch with. YouTube sometimes stops anonymous viewers with "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot", especially when several streams play at once from one network. Being signed in avoids most of these interruptions, and if a camera still won't play in the page, its Watch on YouTube button opens it on youtube.com, where signed-in viewers can watch it.
features: Every selected camera plays muted in a grid sized to fit the screen (the layout picks the column count that gives the biggest tiles)
Phones in portrait: cameras stack one per row at full width and the camera area scrolls (when they don't all fit); turn the phone sideways for the grid
Cameras panel: tick or untick cameras to show or hide them, ▲/▼ to reorder, All / None
Choices are remembered per browser and follow the airport (e.g. LAS), so they survive a stream restarting under a new video ID

Each tile shows its airport code in the bottom-right corner, clear of Flightradar24's own overlay; hover a tile (on phones, tap the code) for its controls beside it: 🔇/🔊 listen to that camera (mutes the others), ⤢…
